rooms.name: Principal Suite
rooms.notes: The principal suite above the street, with a private sitting room adjoining the bedroom.
rooms.suitability: One flight up, with the house's only private bath — a natural pick for the guests of honor or the trip's organizers.

rooms.name: Library Bedroom
rooms.bath: Shared hall bath — exact mapping confirmed in your arrival packet
rooms.notes: Queen bedroom with Pine Street frontage, on the same floor as the formal library.
rooms.suitability: Suits the guest who wants a quieter corner — the formal library is steps away, and the climb stops at one flight.

rooms.name: Second Bedroom
rooms.bath: Shared hall bath — exact mapping confirmed in your arrival packet
rooms.notes: One of two queen bedrooms on the third floor.
rooms.suitability: A middle-of-the-house landing — fewer stairs than the fourth floor.

rooms.name: VIP Bedroom 2
rooms.bath: Shared hall bath — exact mapping confirmed in your arrival packet
rooms.notes: The large VIP suite on the third floor.
rooms.suitability: Room to spread out without climbing to the top of the house.

rooms.name: Family Bedroom 1
rooms.bath: Shared hall bath — exact mapping confirmed in your arrival packet
rooms.notes: One of two connecting family rooms on the fourth floor.
rooms.suitability: The connecting pair suits parents with kids — doors between the rooms, not floors. The fourth floor is the most stairs in a house with no elevator.

rooms.name: Family Bedroom 2
rooms.bath: Shared hall bath — exact mapping confirmed in your arrival packet
rooms.notes: The second of the two connecting family rooms, furnished with a double bed.
rooms.suitability: Assign alongside Family Bedroom 1 for the family that wants to stay within earshot.

rooms.name: Third Bedroom
rooms.bath: Shared hall bath — exact mapping confirmed in your arrival packet
rooms.notes: Queen bedroom at the top of the house.
rooms.suitability: The most stairs and no elevator — assign to the sure-footed.

rooms.name: VIP Bedroom 3
rooms.bath: Shared hall bath — exact mapping confirmed in your arrival packet
rooms.notes: The king VIP suite on the fourth floor.
